title: Chapter 1053
text:
Rumble!

The death energy was like a surging red flood, sweeping across the land and crashing into an energy shield, triggering an endless amount of sparks and electric arcs.

'Mechanical Catastrophe' Francisco's Lord's Avatar opened his arms and maintained the shield, fighting against the flood of death energy. The patterns on his mechanical body all lit up with the bright psionic light, and the thrusters on his back were already at full power, shooting out six deep blue tail flames dozens of meters long. However, he could not stop himself from retreating and was pushed back by the death energy.

Turning around, he saw Red Devil Tolaen and Desolate Beast Mercer hiding behind his shield, occasionally popping their heads out to cast Shockwave Blast or offensive spells before quickly retreating. Seeing this, Mechanical Catastrophe Francois was furious.

You're clearly a melee fighter, yet you're acting like cowards, hiding behind me.

What, are you two using me as a cover?

"Stop messing around, attack!"

Francisco was furious.

The battle had already lasted for a while, and the situation on several battlefields had changed. Black Star and Kasuyna were still 'fighting fiercely', and more and more mechanical troops' broke through 'Kasuyna's defense line and came to support Hella.

Since Hella had more and more helpers, she was free to strengthen her attacks, causing Tolaen and Mercer to become more and more cautious. Originally, the three of them still had the upper hand, but now, the situation was showing signs of equalizing. The main reason was the mechanical troops that Kasuyna had leaked out. With Black Star's Mechanical Force bonuses, they were quite strong and could not be ignored. They perfectly played the role of the best teammates and stirred up sh * t on the battlefield.

The fleet battlefield outside the atmosphere was not looking good either. The mechanical troops controlled by Francisco were being invaded by Han Xiao's Virtual Presence. From time to time, mechanical soldiers would turn around and attack their own people, causing a portion of the fleet to break free from the restraints and provide support to Hella with long-range attacks, distracting the three of them.

[Mechanical Catastrophe] Francisco had to deal damage, tank damage, restrain the fleet, and even split his attention to guard the mechanical army's underwear in the virtual world to prevent Black Star from tearing them apart … Being both a father and a mother at the same time, Francisco felt very tired.

— — It's too hard for me. I can't even sit in jail in peace!

Only Sagman's side could give him some comfort. At this moment, Sagman and Taylor were in a good situation, and they were about to destroy all the stargates.

"Once the two of them complete their mission, they'll be able to come over and help. At that time, we'll be able to break the stalemate and obtain an absolute advantage. We'll be able to crush Hella to death!" Francis thought.

He knew that the Arcane Church had secretly provided Taylor with a special trump card that could control Hella. According to the plan, once the five of them met up, they would use it to deal a fatal blow to Hella.

This trump card was a few magic scrolls, all of which were one-time consumable items. They stored extremely powerful Ethereal exclusive forbidden spells, fused with the power of divine spells.

Among them, the most powerful one was called [Forbidden Spell – Sorrowful Nun's Embrace]. This Forbidden Spell required the cooperation of many people to cast, and it was also very time-consuming to cast. However, it could be cast instantaneously when stored in a Magic Scroll.

Because the Arcane Church had a period of prosperity for the Mages a long time ago, many Beyond Grade A Forbidden Spell scrolls were passed down. The Forbidden Spell stored in this scroll was set up by four Beyond Grade A Mages, and one of them was even a peak Beyond Grade A Mage. As a result, the power of this scroll was extremely high.

Only Taylor, Sagman, and Francis knew about these scrolls. The other teammates did not know about it, including Kasuyi. The Arcane Church knew Kasuyi's character. He was already unwilling to be surrounded by so many people to bully a new Beyond Grade A Super. If he knew that Ethereal was planning to use such a one-time trump card in advance, it might cause some trouble. Therefore, Ethereal did not tell him about it. Their only request for Kasuyi was to block Black Star.

As for why they only told Taylor, Sagman, and Francis, it was because the three of them were the most trustworthy and had the least integrity. Anyway, as long as they used the scroll, the other teammates would focus their fire on them as well.

On the other side, the Crimson Snake had already transformed into its combat form, covering its face. Hila's figure was nimble as she shuttled through the battlefield, scattering death energy while feeling anxious.

She also understood the situation. Although she could hold on for a while with the help of the mechanical army, she knew that this stalemate would be broken very soon. As long as Sagman and Taylor joined the battle, she would definitely not be able to hold on for much longer.

If she did not do anything, she would die a slow death.

Although Han Xiao had just sent her a message saying that his main body was on the way, Hella would not completely rely on others in times of danger. Instead, she would try her best to save herself.

The reinforcements have yet to arrive, and the other two strong enemies will join the battle at any time. If I want to live, I have to survive the siege of the five of them. Even with the help of the mechanical army and the fleet, it's still a hopeless situation. I still have to rely on myself. What other trump cards do I have … Hella kept herself calm and quickly thought about how to get out of this situation.

Ideas popped up one after another, but they were all eliminated by her. Very soon, there was only one way left in her mind.

I can only try my best …

Hella clenched her teeth.

…

The thick beam pierced through the stargate station of the last stronghold. The broken parts flew everywhere. The energy blast of the explosion made the shields of the defense fleet around flicker, triggering plasma arcs one after another.

"The stargate station has been destroyed. Let's go!"

Sagman did not want to continue fighting. He suddenly turned into a cluster of light golden light that enveloped Taylor. Then, he suddenly accelerated, turned into a stream of light, and left the battlefield of the stargate station. Dragging a light golden tail that had the texture of particles, he headed straight for Hila in the distance.

Because he knew that activating the space stabilizing device would affect his summoning skills, Taylor had made preparations in advance. He had already prepared a bunch of summoning scrolls, and when the teleportation device appeared, he crazily tore them apart, creating a rather large number of summoned beasts. As for himself, he temporarily changed his style from the summoning style to the cannon style to adapt to the environment.

He was good at summoning, but that did not mean that he did not learn the spells of other schools. It was just that he was not that good at it.

A Beyond Grade A Super basically had many backup battle styles, especially Mages who were known for having many tricks up their sleeves. No matter what battle style they were good at, they could always turn it into a cannon when needed. Regardless of whether the firepower was strong or not, as long as they could shoot, it would be fine.

Under Kasuyi's control, a small number of mechanical soldiers were able to pass through, and they tried to stop the two of them.

However, in light form, Sagman was extremely nimble. He took many twists and turns, but he did not engage the mechanical army head-on. It was only because Taylor was a Beyond Grade A that he was carrying. If it were an ordinary person, they would have probably vomited their guts out.

Sagman's Esper Ability was related to light energy, so his turning speed was extremely fast. He drew a huge circle, shook off the mechanical soldiers that tried to stop him, and entered the battlefield where Hella was, hovering in midair of the planet.

"You're finally here. Hurry and help!"

[Mechanical Catastrophe] Francisco had had enough of orphaned teammates, so he was as excited as if he had seen his family.

Sagman and Taylor looked at each other and saw the meaning in each other's eyes.

Create an opportunity and use the Forbidden Spell Scroll!

The two of them did not say anything and joined the battle.

Light energy shockwaves and offensive spells were cast out like they did not cost money, showing their explosive nature.

Rumble!!

Explosions occurred in midair, and mechanical soldiers were shot down one after another. Hella was instantly surrounded by danger, and she had no choice but to stop all her attacks and focus on defense.

After the two of them joined the team, their combat power was completely overwhelming. It was like a seesaw. With the help of the fleet and the mechanical army, Hila finally managed to pull the slanted board to the center. At this time, two 300-kilogram babies came from the other side and sat down, sending Hila, who was on the other side, flying.

…

At the same time, in the battlefield outside the atmosphere, Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar glanced at Hella's predicament and said in Kasuyi's exclusive chat window, "Hella won't be able to block the attacks of five people. Don't block me and let me through."

"How do you want to act?" Kasuyi asked.

"Give me a hard one. Send my Lord's Avatar and part of my mechanical army over."

"Ethereal asked me to stall you, so it's impossible for me to send you back. Furthermore, if you join that battlefield, I'll have to follow you. At that time, I'll have to make a move on Hella, and she'll be in more danger." Kasuyi shook his head slightly.

Acting was acting, and he did not plan to offend Ethereal. Although the water he had given in was enough to form an ocean, Kasuyi could not do it openly. Otherwise, it would be difficult to explain.

"Then … why don't you use an AOE attack at the critical moment and interrupt your teammates' attacks. Just say that it was an accident."

"My psychic power can be retracted and released freely. There's no possibility of accidental injury."

"Then … why don't you just let me destroy your avatar? That's the most convenient."

"No, let's not talk about whether your Lord's Avatar has the ability to defeat my avatar. I still have to stay here to prevent any accidents. That old guy from the Mecha Empire said that Radiance is going to make a move. I have to pretend to snatch Hella from them and restrain some of them."

Han Xiao was speechless.

What was the self-cultivation of an actor? This was it!

This was so professional that it touched Ethereal!

"This won't work, that won't work. What should we do?"

"Radiance will come out at any time," Kasuyi said. "At that time, I can turn around and attack Radiance, and her situation will not be so dangerous … If Hella can hold on for now, it's best to wait and see what happens."

"I have to think about it …" Han Xiao pondered.

The two actors were quietly looking at the script, but at this time, something unexpected happened!

Swoosh!

Under the crazy attacks of the five people, Hella revealed a slight opening. 'Mechanical Catastrophe' Francisco took the opportunity and clapped his hands, releasing an extremely strong plasma electromagnetic field that passed through the gap created by the death energy and applied on Hella.

Sizzle!

The electric arcs crackled, and Hella's body froze. Her movements revealed a bigger opening.

Sagman and Francisco chased after her and threw out even more powerful control skills to restrain Hella.

"Strange, since we joined the team, she has been a little distracted …"

This thought flashed through Sagman's mind, but before he could think about it, he shouted at Taylor in the mental group chat.

"Use the scroll!"

"I've already prepared it!"

Without saying anything, Taylor tore open a black magic scroll with white patterns. The scroll suddenly shone brightly!

Hualala!

It was as if a thousand-year-old cage had been opened. Countless pale white magic runes shot out of the scroll like wild dragons that had just broken free, all of them hitting Hila.

The next moment, the surface of Crimson Snake — First Generation's armor was covered with strange pale white runes. The overall outline was like the shape of an enchanting woman, and it attached itself to Hella's body in the form of a rune pattern. The female pattern slowly opened her arms and made a hugging motion.

Hum!

A strange force suddenly descended, and Hila realized that her mobility had been sealed. Her body was fixed in midair, and her energy quickly calmed down. She could not move at all.

[Forbidden Spell — Weeping Nun's Embrace]!

"Focus fire!"

The control time was limited, so Sagman did not dare waste any time. He roared in the group chat and used all his attack methods to bombard Hella.

Tolaen and Mercer immediately reacted. Although they did not know what was going on, they would not let go of such a good opportunity to attack. They both unleashed their strongest attacks.

Rumble!

Hella's figure was instantly drowned in the colorful explosion of energy.

It looked bright and dazzling, but it was actually very powerful!

Kasuyi's doppelganger suddenly turned around.

"Forbidden Spell Scroll?"

Did Xu Ling still have a trick up his sleeve?!

Seeing this, he did not intend to negotiate anymore. Psychic power gushed out, grabbed all the mechanical troops including Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar, and threw them directly toward Hella's battlefield to provide him with acceleration.

"Damn, he's really decisive."

Flying in midair, Han Xiao used Kasuyi's momentum to accelerate toward Hella's position. However, he was not in a hurry.

Kasuyi did not know Hella's situation and thought that Hella was in danger. However, Han Xiao knew that Hella had the ability to instantly revive. Although this wave of attacks seemed fierce, it would not be able to kill Hella. It would only be able to knock out her revival ability.

"However, this means that I might have to use a backup plan." Han Xiao frowned.

If Hella's instant revival ability was not knocked out, he could take the risk later. However, now, Han Xiao felt that he might have to change his plan.

However, before he arrived at the battlefield, a dense life energy suddenly erupted at Hella's position!

Wu!

Golden life energy shot up into the sky like a fountain!

The vigorous aura made everyone stunned at the same time.

Sagman and the other four, who were bombarding indiscriminately, were shocked to find that although they kept causing heavy damage to Hella, those shocking injuries recovered in a breath's time!

After the effect of the Forbidden Spell ended, Hella broke free from the shackles and escaped. Her Crimson First Edition was already in tatters, revealing large areas of skin covered in bloody wounds.

However, the life energy nourished her body, and the wounds that opened up closed in the blink of an eye. Not even a scar was left behind, and her skin became smooth and white again.

Sagman and the others widened their eyes in shock.

How is this possible!

Such a terrifying recovery ability …

How does she have such strength?

Also, why does it feel a little familiar …

The next moment, everyone turned their heads and looked at Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar in midair in shock.

Isn't … isn't this Black Star's ability?

Why does Hella have it too?

If there were any similarities between the two of them …

Could this be the traditional ability of Blue Star people?

At this moment, Kasuyi's voice sounded faintly.

"Black Star, are you Blue Star people all unkillable?"

"No, we don't have that kind of talent …" Han Xiao smiled awkwardly.

If it wasn't his Lord's Avatar but his main body, he would probably take a deep breath.

Hella had opened up the Distance Life Link with Aurora during the battle. Otherwise, how could she burst out with life energy?

She actually learned a new ability at the last minute. Little sister, are you also a main character type character?

That doesn't make sense. You're clearly a villain.

Han Xiao was speechless. To Hella, activating the Distance Life Link with Aurora was equivalent to opening up her conception and governing vessels, and she could fly into the sky in an instant!

Her combat power didn't increase, but she always had a super healer with her. As long as Aurora didn't exhaust her stamina, Hella had terrifying recovery ability, endurance, and endurance!

Han Xiaoxin's head twitched, and he almost wanted to call the police.

I thought I was already crazy enough, but I didn't expect you to be such a cheat!

If Hella also had this' accessory 'of Aurora in his previous life … he didn't dare to imagine what the result would be.

It was a pity that before Hella's cheat could be obtained, it was destroyed by the Germinal Organization leader.

"Again!"

Hila's aura surged, and her battle intent surged.

The current Aurora could already use this method to fight side by side with her, helping her escape a life and death crisis. As the saying went, sisters of the same mind could cut through metal. Hella's mentality was already different from before, and she didn't reject Aurora's help.

The recovery of a Beyond Grade A Super required even more life force energy, but Aurora had also entered the Calamity Grade, so her stamina was long enough to back her up, giving her the ability to do whatever she wanted.

Hearing Hella's clamor, Sagman and the others were bewildered and didn't know if they should continue to attack.

Han Xiao stopped in midair and did not continue to approach. Kasuyi also watched from afar.

Everyone stopped what they were doing. They looked at each other and stared at each other. Suddenly, the atmosphere was filled with a strange atmosphere.

However, at this moment, everyone present suddenly felt a strange fluctuation, and they all turned their heads to look at it.

Buzz!

Not far away from the stronghold, a Radiant Federation fleet broke through the space stabilization device and appeared on the battlefield.

In front of the fleet, seven Beyond Grade As stood in a row, looking at everyone present. The gazes of both sides collided in midair.

Kasuyi looked up and said, "They're here."

Seeing such a flashy entrance, Han Xiao could not help but praise the other party in his heart.

Radiant Federation, join the battle!
